notes.title: Patch 1.1 : Huge Gameplay Changes !
notes.content:
Hello ! I'm glad to show you the new version of No More Enemies !

What's new ? 2 Major changes !

[h1]A new map size[/h1]
The map size has been reduced from 20 blocks to 12 blocks to allow players to navigate more easily and better feel the uniqueness if each map.

To adjust for this change, trapped blocks now appear by 2 instead of 3.

[h1]A new starting skill set [/h1]

From now on, at the beginning of each run you can choose 2 skills between all the skills of the champion ! It's no longer a single choice between 2 fixed skills.

[h1]New content coming soon ! [/h1]

[h2]Steam Demo [/h2]
The first one is the Steam demo of the game coming next week !

[h2]New monster[/h2]
The second one is the introdution of a new monster :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321858/d15855070817dbeea33808d565df1dd72cbd7a75.png[/img]

Can you guess what it does ?


[h1]Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Corrected bug that crashed the game when killed by death
[*] Added the beginner mode automatically if you don't have any wins
[*] Made the beginner mode easier
[*] Made the camera movement smoother
[*] Corrected AutoAttack for projectile weapons to target enemies in sight
[/list]

See you soon !

notes.title: The Demo is here !
notes.content:
Hello ! It's been a while since the last patch,

I have mostly work on a demo for No More Enemies :

[url=https://dryquest-studio.itch.io/no-more-enemies-demo][u]Try the FREE Demo here ![/u][/url]

I'm really excited to know your thoughts about the game, feel free to give your feedbacks !


I have also added some changes to the game :
- New visual for invicibility power-up
- New visual for the minimap
- Changed monster SFX to be different depending of the size
- Death & MiniDeath are slower in beginner mode
- Corrected a bug making the game crash when Death killed you

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hi ! If you find some bugs don't hesitate to report it. Today's list of changes are :
- Tear of Joy reworked to be a better support item for damage taken build
- Yggdrasil's sap heal reduced to a random between 67-100% of health instead of always 100 %
- Added a tips sign at the beginning of the rift

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.0.3
notes.content:
Changed how the save system works to correct a bug preventing Steam Cloud to update the new unlocked items. Unfortunately it will reset the progression of the game for those who played until now, sorry for that.

To make amends, as soon as the major bugs are fixed I'll add a new monster in the game !

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
